events.text: The Instagram group direct message called Chahta Babes is created. Reed’s goal was to bridge and bring together Choctaw women and 2S folks interested in tattoos and Choctaw culture.

Through the relationships built in that group, and inspired by Yappali, the idea emerges to rewalk the Trail of Tears together and receive traditional tattoos at the end. As the logistical and informational challenges become clear, the catalyst for the Inchunwa Project is born.
